scriptText:
I. PART 1

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic dark fantasy animated sequence rendered in a European graphic novel aesthetic, featuring @ROSA as Rosa (voice: @voice_rosa), a resolute young princess wearing a thorn crown, and @ROBERT as Robert (voice: @voice_robert), her translucent floating spectral mentor, as she marches through a petrified primordial grove toward an ancient glowing root fissure while defying his desperate ghostly pleas to turn back.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Ensure absolute spatial continuity across the left-to-right travelling path through the dormant grove, keeping Robert hovering at weightless shoulder height relative to Rosa's heavy, purposeful stride. Preserve the dual-source lighting schema throughout, contrasting Robert's cold cyan spectral emission against the warm golden-amber illumination erupting from the subterranean fissure. Avoid crossing the northern axis of action to maintain readable screen direction and eye-lines. Prioritize grounded physical weight and fabric momentum for Rosa while keeping Robert semi-translucent with fluid particulate dissipation. Ensure the mycelial forest floor reacts with radiating bioluminescent pulses wherever physical contact occurs.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: Franco-Belgian graphic novel animation, clean ink contour linework, textured matte gouache shading, fine digital watercolor wash, subtle organic pigment grain
Palette: Midnight indigo, charcoal slate, calcified bone-white, phosphorescent cyan, incandescent molten amber
Lighting: Low-key twilight ambience, soft omnidirectional cool cyan rim-light emitted by the ghost, intense warm amber up-light cast from the subterranean root fissure
Location: The Dormant Grove, colossal weeping petrified white trunks streaked with crystallized amber resin, dense frost-like mycelial floor, steaming subterranean root chasm
Wardrobe: Rosa wearing an intricate forged silver thorn crown resting above her brow, a heavy tattered navy-blue velvet travel mantle fastened with tarnished silver clasps over a tailored dark-grey textured wool adventurer tunic with reinforced leather braces and sturdy travelling boots; Robert wearing a faded slate-blue quilted gambeson under a weathered dark-leather cuirass with utilitarian travel pauldrons, rendered entirely as a weightless, semi-translucent apparition trailing cold cyan particulate mist
Audio: Diegetic only, crunch of frozen mycelial moss underfoot, subterranean tectonic hum, ethereal vapor dissipation, distant cold winds through petrified canopy
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
Full shot, low-angle perspective looking slightly upward from camera-left of the travel path. In the midground, Rosa stands poised in mid-stride facing frame-right, her silver thorn crown catching faint twilight gleam and her heavy navy-blue velvet mantle draping over textured wool travel attire, her leather boots resting upon a dense carpet of frost-like pale mycelium that glows with a soft cyan bioluminescent pulse beneath her sole. Floating weightlessly in the frame-right midground, the translucent, ice-blue glowing spectral figure of Robert hovers above the mossy floor, turned back toward Rosa with a furrowed brow of urgent concern. In the background, massive petrified bone-white weeping tree trunks with twisted muscular bark loom into thick indigo ground mist, streaked with dark veins of fossilized sap.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] FS TRACKING, moving parallel from camera-left -> [STATE IN] Rosa marches toward frame-right across the responsive mycelium -> [ACT] Rosa advances with steady, heavy footfalls as her velvet mantle billows behind her, while the translucent figure of Robert glides backward through the air just ahead -> Robert says (firm whisper) {Rosa, stop.} -> [ACT] Rosa strides straight past his floating form without breaking rhythm -> Robert says (urgent, breathless) {Look at the ridge. There’s smoke.} -> <Ethereal mist parting with a soft hiss as boots crunch over frozen moss>
[CAM] MS TRACKING, leading Rosa backward from a low frontal angle -> [STATE IN] Rosa occupies center frame, cold mist curling past her set jaw -> Rosa says (low, strained effort) {I see it.} -> [ACT] Rosa narrows her dark eyes straight ahead, ignoring the cold cyan glow reflecting across her cheekbones -> Robert (O.S.) says (pleading) {Then why are you here?} -> <Rhythmic compression of brittle bioluminescent carpet under heavy leather soles>
[CAM] MS LATERAL TRACKING, maintaining camera-left profile orientation -> [BLOCK] Rosa continues her forward march in the midground while Robert drifts horizontally beside her at eye level -> Robert says (insistent) {Every minute here brings the fire closer to your mother’s gates.} -> [ACT] Rosa tilts her chin slightly, cold subterranean drafts stirring her dark-streaked hair while her pace remains relentless -> Rosa says (resigned sigh) {I know what’s at stake, Robert.} -> <Low acoustic vibration humming through underground root networks>
[CAM] MS LOW-ANGLE, panning gently to maintain both characters in frame -> [ACT] Robert descends directly into Rosa's forward visual path, hovering backward just above the frost -> Robert says (sharp whisper) {Then act like it.} -> [ACT] Spectral vapor streams from Robert's outstretched hands as he drifts backward in desperate appeal -> Robert says (cracked voice) {I bought you this road.} -> <Soft crystalline chime of glowing spores scattering through the cold air>
[CAM] OTS over Rosa’s right shoulder toward Robert's floating spectral torso -> [STATE IN] Robert hovers midground facing camera, backlit by atmospheric blue mist -> Rosa (O.S.) says (sharp, bitter exhale) {You threw yourself away.} -> [ACT] Robert winces, his ethereal face tightening with profound sorrow and wounded pride -> Robert says (choked gasp) {I cleared your path!} -> <Deep resonant tremor shaking loose frost flakes from overhead petrified branches>
[CAM] MS THREE-QUARTER PROFILE, tracking alongside the travel axis -> [ACT] Robert sweeps across her path, reaching an intangible spectral arm toward her shoulder as cold blue light flares around him -> Robert says (desperate) {Take the horses. Cross the border.} -> [ACT] Rosa marches directly through his translucent form without flinching, stepping into a rising amber glow -> Rosa says (fierce, resolute murmur) {Not alone.} -> <Subtle electrostatic crackle as her velvet cloak passes through the freezing phantom mist>
[CAM] WS HIGH-ANGLE, looking downward at the central grove nexus -> [BLOCK] Rosa halts at frame-center before a gaping subterranean root split, with Robert floating down beside her shoulder -> [ACT] Rosa plants her boots at the rim of the steaming chasm as radiant golden-amber light washes across her silhouette -> Robert says (pleading whisper) {The old stories are a trap, Rosa.} -> <Simmering hum of subterranean heat and thick bubbling resin within the deep fissure>
[CAM] MS TWO-SHOT PROFILE, fixed at the root chasm edge -> [STATE IN] Rosa stands on frame-left illuminated by rising gold light, Robert floats on frame-right illuminated by cyan mist -> Robert says (trembling whisper) {Whatever is down there... leave it in the dirt.} -> [ACT] Rosa lowers her posture to one knee at the fissure edge, extending her gloved hand toward the luminous depths with unwavering resolve -> Rosa says (quiet, absolute resolve) {I’m bringing you back.} -> <Deep rhythmic thrum radiating outward like a subterranean pulse of golden warmth>
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART 2

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Continue from @PREVIOUS_CLIP as @ROSA as Rosa, the determined princess, defies the spectral warnings of @ROBERT as Robert, tearing a beating primordial heart from a molten chasm to restore him to mortal flesh at terrible cost in this dramatic Franco-Belgian animated fantasy sequence.
[[/INTENT]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Maintain absolute spatial continuity from last frame of @PREVIOUS_CLIP, locking Rosa at frame-left along the crystalline root precipice and Robert at frame-right over the glowing fissure. Preserve exact character model proportions, Rosa's silver crown geometry and blonde hair streak, and Robert's knightly armor engravings throughout the visual transformation. Prioritize match-on-action transitions, transferring Robert from weightless ethereal floating to solid, grounded physical mass slamming into the frozen ground.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: Diegetic only, no musical score, featuring natural Foley, bubbling sap churn, splintering timber, heavy steel impacts, raspy vocal strain, and deep resonant subterranean pulses.
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
Last Frame of @PREVIOUS_CLIP
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MS, SLOW PUSH IN on axis -> [STATE IN] Rosa crouched frame-left above fissure, Robert floating frame-right -> [BLOCK] Rosa deepens her stance into a solid runner's crouch, spreading her gloved fingers directly over the molten surface while Robert drifts forward in futile restraint -> [ENV] The calm molten pool begins to churn and boil violently as the bioluminescent cyan moss along the perimeter dims into pitch black -> [VFX] Swirling golden embers rise through the cavernous root chasm -> <Low rhythmic subterranean rumble and bubbling liquid heat>
[CAM] MCU, LOW ANGLE tilted upward on Rosa -> [AXIS] Maintained looking screen-right -> [ACT] Rosa fixes her unblinking gaze into the boiling depths, her jaw clenching with fierce determination -> Rosa says (low rhythmic whisper) {Break the pale root. Break the vessel...} -> [VFX] Blinding golden radiance surges upward across her face, casting sharp dancing shadows across her silver crown -> Rosa says (mounting vocal grit) {...Vital essence for breath. Life answers life.} -> [ACT] Her eyes narrow with uncompromising resolve -> <Hissing steam jets and rising thermal wind>
[CAM] CU, HIGH ANGLE looking straight down into the molten fissure -> [STATE IN] Rosa's leather-gloved hands hovering just above the magma surface -> Robert says (O.S. desperate frantic shout) {Rosa, look at the grove! Stop!} -> [ACT] Rosa plunges both hands and forearms directly into the searing golden sap without hesitation -> [VFX] Viscous golden resin ripples violently outward, splashing against the petrified root edges -> <Violent searing thermal sizzle and splashing molten magma>
[CAM] MS, PROFILE TRACKING along the ledge -> [STATE IN] Rosa submerged elbow-deep in boiling amber -> [ACT] Rosa's shoulders lock and her back arches as her hands grip a colossal, throbbing mass deep within the subterranean core -> Rosa says (straining exertion through clenched teeth) {Nnngh—come on!} -> [ENV] Surrounding petrified roots contract violently, twisting tightly around her forearms -> [ACT] Rosa leans her entire body backward, heels digging firmly into the frosty shelf -> <Heavy wet suction and snapping fibrous wood>
[CAM] MCU, DYNAMIC LOW ANGLE looking up at Rosa -> [ACT] Rosa throws her entire torso backward in one explosive heave -> Rosa says (guttural roar) {BREAK!} -> [ACT] Rosa wrenches a colossal pulsating amber heart out of the chasm and stumbles backward onto both knees, cradling the blazing organ to her chest -> [VFX] Molten golden sap splatters across her navy cloak and forearms in radiant arcs -> <Violent wet rupture and deep resonant heartbeat thud>
[CAM] EWS, HIGH ANGLE CRANE PULL revealing the wider clearing -> [STATE IN] Blinding golden shockwave detonating outward from the extracted organ -> Robert says (O.S. suffocating wheeze) {Ah... khhk...} -> [ENV] Surrounding bone-white tree trunks twist and deform with agonizing elasticity, splitting open into hollow screaming faces that weep heavy streams of dark amber resin -> [VFX] Searing golden radiance completely overtakes the dim grove -> <Deafening chorus of shrieking timber and rushing shockwave wind>
[CAM] MS, RAPID DOLLY IN on Robert mid-air -> [STATE IN] Robert hovering translucent at frame-right -> [VFX] Piercing golden shockwave engulfs his form, instantly burning away cyan translucency and solidifying him into opaque natural skin, weathered leather, and heavy steel plate -> [ACT] Weightlessness vanishes as gravity seizes Robert; he crashes heavily onto all fours against the frozen stone floor, his steel armor clattering hard against the rock -> [STATE OUT] Robert trembles on hands and knees, chest violently heaving as freezing air floods his physical lungs -> <Loud steel plate clattering against rock and raspy shuddering gasps>
[CAM] MCU, GROUND LEVEL looking past Robert's trembling shoulders toward Rosa -> [BLOCK] Robert in foreground-right, Rosa kneeling in midground-left -> [ACT] Robert slowly lifts his head, eyes wide with horrified awe at the screaming weeping canopy before locking onto the radiant heart in Rosa's hands -> Robert says (hoarse trembling whisper) {Rosa... this was a mistake.} -> [ACT] Robert's gauntleted fingers claw into the frost as his breath billows white in the cold air -> <Deep resonant thrum of the beating heart and ragged exhalation>
[CAM] FS, LOW ANGLE HERO COMPOSITION looking up past the kneeling commander -> [BLOCK] Robert stays kneeling on all fours frame-right; Rosa rises to her feet frame-left -> [STATE IN] Rosa standing tall over Robert, hands and tunic drenched in glowing amber resin -> [ACT] Rosa firmly holds the furiously throbbing heart before her chest, looking down at Robert with unwavering conviction while her navy mantle billows in the thermal draft -> [ENV] Weeping screaming faces across the pale timber canopy loom behind them under flashing golden illumination -> <Heavy rhythmic cardiac pulse and distant groaning timber>
[</BRIEF>]
